item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU’s Human-Robot System for Smart Manufacturing
item.description: PolyU has developed an advanced human-robot collaboration system that enables flexible, intelligent, autonomous and high-precision manufacturing for complex Industry 5.0 tasks across industrial sectors.

item.title: Vietnam: Technology, Skills and Innovation to Boost Industrial Growth
item.description: Prime Minister Chinh emphasises that technology, digitalisation, innovation, and workforce skills are central to Vietnam’s industrial growth and economic development goals for 2026.

item.title: Malaysia: MPI Backs Smart Transformation of Media Industry
item.description: Malaysia’s Media Innovation Fund, backed by MPI, aims to drive smart, technology-driven transformation, enhance digital skills and strengthen capabilities in the country’s media industry.

item.title: Indonesia: BSSN, Planning Ministry to Boost National Cyber Resilience
item.description: Indonesia’s BSSN and the Ministry of National Development Planning have signed a 5-year agreement to enhance cybersecurity and support the nation’s digital transformation and resilience.

item.title: Malaysia: Data, Geospatial Tech Aid Smarter Village Governance
item.description: Melaka’s i-MULA 5.0 platform integrates data management and geospatial technologies to modernise village administration and strengthen digital governance.

item.title: India: IIT Madras offers AI Capacity-Building for Government
item.description: IIT Madras, in partnership with a global technology company and the Digital Futures Lab, has launched a programme to train Indian government officials in responsible AI deployment, governance and adoption.

item.title: Australia: Remote Sensing and AI Advance Koala Habitat Mapping
item.description: University-led research combines hyperspectral airborne imagery and machine learning to map eucalyptus nutritional quality and distribution, enabling large-scale, data-driven conservation of koala habitats.

item.title: Thailand, China Strengthen Smart Agriculture Collaboration
item.description: Thailand and China are strengthening smart agriculture through research collaboration, technology exchange and human resource development to advance innovation, productivity and sustainable farming in the region.

item.title: Hong Kong: Digital Tech Transforms Elderly Stroke Recovery
item.description: A smart geriatric rehabilitation programme in Hong Kong effectively uses tele-rehabilitation and immersive digital technologies to significantly improve elderly stroke recovery while reducing frequent hospital visits.

item.title: Vietnam: Advancing Digital and Semiconductor Leadership
item.description: Vietnam is strongly pushing to advance its digital economy, semiconductor industry and technological capabilities under the “Make in Vietnam” spirit, focusing on innovation, skills and sustainable growth.
